Install ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic on Omarchy

This is JetBrains' popular monospaced coding typeface run through the Nerd Fonts patcher, which adds glyphs from icon sets like Font Awesome, Devicons, and Octicons directly into the font. Terminal prompts, file-manager TUIs, and status bars that expect Nerd Font icon glyphs (folder icons, git branch symbols, language logos, and so on) render correctly once this font is installed and selected.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 3.5.1-2:
    pacman -Qi ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic

Open and use ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic

ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic | grep /usr/bin/

Frequently asked questions

How do I install ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic. The download is 5.6 MB and it takes 10.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic free?

Free and open source (SIL Open Font License). The package is licensed OFL-1.1-no-RFN.

How do I uninstall ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic?

Run omarchy pkg drop ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic. It removes the package from your system.

What does ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic depend on?

ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic a desktop app?

No. ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic (version 3.5.1-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Ryan L McIntyre makes it. Project site: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts.
